title: First headset test changes: P-34 rapid fire in code, fire-cadence carry (T-0043), eye height, barrel length, closer sandbox range
acceptance: Cannon defaults match P-34 and the balance sim; heat parity test passes at 1 ms and at 72 Hz within one frame and 1%
Gatebreaker core 6,500 HP, collapse at 1,950, core falls in 2-3 exposures at 70% with the real heat model
Design eye 10 cm lower, barrels 80 cm, sandbox objective and entrances closer
All ETM tests pass; repackaged APK installed on the Quest 3
description: From the owner's first headset session on 2026-11-18: floor a little low and far, cannons too long, wants fast fire with about 100 shots before overheating (P-34, owner chose 25 damage per shot). Includes T-0043 (carry the fire-cooldown remainder), which matters more at 10 shots/s.

history.note: Owner retested on the Quest 3: feels good, approved in chat. Recorded on the owner's behalf by claude-code-dartonx-pc.

result.summary: P-34 rapid fire in code (10/s, 25 dmg, heat 1 -> 100 shots in 9.9 s), fire-cooldown remainder carried (T-0043), Gatebreaker core 6500 (phase 3 at 1950), design eye Z 110, barrels/muzzle 80 cm, HUD heat bar at 63, sandbox objective 3.5 m and entrances 18 m. Branch stacked on t-0053 (sandbox).
result.verification: Editor build; all 78 ETM automation tests pass (72 Hz heat parity now within one frame and 1%); Android APK packaged and installed on the Quest 3. Standalone g++ heat test updated but not run (no compiler on this PC). Owner retest in the headset pending.
